summary: Iteration 5 — Frontend validation of NEW AutoLenis features: Featured Inventory carousel, redesigned two-plan pricing, signup plan selector, and light-theme redesign of admin/dealer/affiliate auth pages. All acceptance criteria met with ZERO functional/console errors on public pages.
critical_code_review_comments: All data-testid attributes requested in the review request are present and correctly wired: featured-inventory-section, featured-vehicle-<uuid> (x3), featured-inventory-browse-all, pricing-plan-standard, pricing-plan-premium, pricing-premium-badge, pricing-deposit-callout, signup-plan-selector, signup-plan-standard, signup-plan-premium.

Featured Inventory renders 3 real DB vehicles (2022 Tesla Model 3 $34,500, 2023 Toyota Camry $28,900, 2023 BMW 3 Series $37,800). 'Browse All Vehicles' link correctly points to /inventory. Each card href goes to /inventory/<uuid> and the detail page loads real DB data (Tesla detail page shows full H1 '2022 Tesla Model 3 Long Range AWD' and price).

Pricing page: Standard card shows 'Free to start' with 10 bullet <li> items and CTA /auth/signup?plan=standard. Premium card shows $499 concierge fee, 8 bullet <li> items, '★ MOST POPULAR' badge, CTA /auth/signup?plan=premium. $99 deposit callout is present with full explanation. Side-by-side layout rendered correctly.

Signup plan selector: Standard has aria-pressed='true' by default, Premium has aria-pressed='false'. Clicking Premium flips the pressed state correctly. Clicking Standard back flips again. Navigating to /auth/signup?plan=premium pre-selects Premium (aria-pressed='true' on premium, 'false' on standard). Submit button label also switches from 'Create Standard Account' to 'Create Premium Account'.
Home page TRUST_ITEMS third card now reads 'Two Simple Plans' — the old 'One Flat Fee' string was NOT found in the DOM. Confirmed.

Admin signin, setup-mfa, verify-mfa pages all render with body background rgb(255,255,255) (white) and a soft light-purple gradient. ZERO elements with near-black backgrounds (rgb<20,<20,<20) — the old #0A0A0A dark theme has been fully removed. setup-mfa/verify-mfa correctly route via client-side auth-gate but the shell renders in light theme.

Dealer signin (/dealer/signin) and Affiliate register (/affiliate/register): body backgrounds are white; the left hero panel uses a purple gradient (visually confirmed via screenshot — purple → deep blue gradient with brand logo and benefits copy); right form panel is white with light purple accents. The old near-black #05030A backgrounds are gone. Visual layout matches the spec (two-panel split with brand hero on left, form on right).

One non-critical console 401 observed on /affiliate/register — this appears to be an auth-status fetch that returns 401 for unauthenticated visitors (expected behavior). No page crash, no UX impact, form still renders and is interactive. Main agent may choose to silence this to tidy console output but NOT a bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — 7/7 target pages validated, 18/18 data-testid/acceptance criteria met, 0 console errors on public pages, 1 expected auth-probe 401 on affiliate/register (non-blocking)

test_credentials: No auth required. Admin credentials available in /app/memory/test_credentials.md but not exercised (setup/verify MFA pages only checked for theme, not full auth flow, per main agent note).
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Existing 6 vehicles in DB used by Featured Inventory (top 3) and /inventory.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new iteration-5 features validated end-to-end on preview URL https://e2e-sandbox-check.preview.emergentagent.com: Featured Inventory (3 cards + browse-all), Pricing redesign (Standard+Premium+$99 callout), Signup plan selector (default/toggle/?plan=premium deep-link), Admin light theme (signin/setup-mfa/verify-mfa), Dealer+Affiliate purple-gradient hero (replaces dark #05030A). Buyer portal deposit/payment pages skipped per main agent instruction (require authenticated buyer). DocuSign skipped per user instruction.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found. Everything matches acceptance criteria.
